title: Voyage home to Seattle and meeting Duke Ellington's band
summary: After leaving Japan in June they return by Victory ship to Seattle, listen to the Louis Conn fight, meet Ellington's band, and go home by train.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And our stay in Japan lasted until about the second, third week in June. Second week in June, because we were three weeks --

Three weeks getting back. And we came back to Yokinama, and we boarded another boat. This was a different boat. This was a Victory ship, a larger boat. And we were supposed to go into Seattle -- I mean, go into Frisco, and we went into Seattle. And on our way back, we were laying out on deck in the sunshine, listening to the Conn and Joe Louis fight. Coming back.

And we arrived in Seattle, we spent just one day in Seattle. Duke Ellington's band was playing at one of the big places there. We had a chance to fraternize with Duke, the boys in the band. And the next day we left by train. We left for Chicago. We changed trains in Chicago, didn't we, Charles?
Uh-huh. You all did. I went on to New York.
You went to New York, I went to St. Louis, and then I left St. Louis the following day and --
